decisions.reason: Define-XML ADAE.TRTEMFL assigns 'N' otherwise, and the literal probe at adae-probe.yaml lines 140-147 applies that branch after the documented nonmissing date comparison. The 65 differences are reference blanks where the documented rule gives 'N', the blank that adae_v2.yaml lines 576-582 also assign.

Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM compares AEBODSYS with the literal 'SKIN AND SUBC UTANEOUS TISSUE DISORDERS', which the probe keeps with the substring test and exact exclusions, so the 181 differences follow from that spelling. Removing only the embedded blank reproduces the reference, consistent with the dermatologic query that ADRG page-11 describes.

Within Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL, CQ01NAM='' selects records outside the populated dermatologic query, while the same method's parenthetical says to flag the first treatment-emergent dermatological event. Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM assigns 'DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS' to query members and missing otherwise, so these clauses describe different subsets.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL selects empty CQ01NAM, whereas ADRG pages 11-12 explicitly flag the first chronological treatment-emergent dermatological event. Define-XML ADAE.CQ01NAM identifies dermatological query members by the populated 'DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS' value, making the subsets contradictory.

Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL literally subsets to CQ01NAM='', and the probe applies that filter with TRTEMFL='Y', subject grouping and ASTDT then AESEQ ordering, giving the 327 differences. The populated-query reading, supported by the method's own parenthetical and ADRG pages 11-12, reproduces the reference.

Define-XML ADAE.AENDY and workbook Methods row 25 compute AENDY from AENDT and TRTSDT, while AENDY at adae_v1.yaml line 237 copies the SDTM study day AE.AEENDY and adae_v2.yaml lines 229-239 add only submission metadata. These are different sources and computations, not a paraphrase.

Define-XML ADAE.TRTEMFL assigns 'N' otherwise, while the TRTEMFL derivation at adae_v2.yaml line 582 assigns a blank, as its comment at line 576 states. The method description at lines 591-592 repeats the 'N' text, but no derivation branch implements it.

AESEQ need not follow start-date order, so the stated ordering differs, not only its wording.

missed.quote:
ADAE contains one record per reported event per subject. Subjects who did not report any
Adverse Events are not represented in this dataset. The data reference for ADAE is the SDTM
AE (Adverse Events) domain and there is a 1-1 correspondence between records in the source
and this analysis dataset.
missed.reason: ADRG page-11 states the ADAE record scope, one record per reported AE with a 1-1 correspondence to SDTM AE, and no claim cites it. It governs the all-aes row rule (adae_v1.yaml lines 585-588, dataset AE), outside the variable-derivation claims.
